items.claim: The vault sweep says real money sits in selling AI UGC and brand faces to businesses on retainers, though most big numbers are self-reported.
A free MIT Mac app learns any song from Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube in a couple of minutes and scores your singing against its pitch track.
On a 2 GB TCL Google TV it disabled 25 bloat apps and cut home screen memory from 192 MB to 83 MB.
Across ten models, resistance to missing evidence varies widely, and giving recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all of them.
An MCP server and public registry that decodes 402 challenges and recommends a payment rail, with no tool able to spend money.
There is an official publisher-sanctioned marketplace for paid FiveM and RedM assets.
Turns an SVG into 60 fps animation with live faces and full-body acting, by teaching the agent animator's rules.
A Qwen3-8B model trained this way beats Llama-4-Maverick (402B) on ToolBench and transfers to other retrievers and corpora.
Open-source scrape, map and crawl toolkit for agents, returning Markdown and checked fields with failure reasons; keyless hosted trial allows five pages a day.
Labelled subscription personas on AI-friendly platforms can earn, though visible big numbers are mostly self-reported or sold by course sellers.
Access control for multi-user agents: per-user credentials, fine-grained runtime policy and compliance-grade audit logs through a proxy.
